brief:
A Palestinian media delegation concluded visits to Brussels and Paris, the Palestine News Network reported, attending an international media conference organized by French media development agency CFI. The journalists held a series of meetings during their European tour.

The delegation called for greater international support for press freedom, according to the reporting, as part of their engagement with European media institutions and development organizations.

title: Palestinian media delegation seeks international backing for press freedom
